text: Before full rollout, Lena Ortiz runs Wrenfield's standard red-team review: deliberate prompt-injection attempts, mixed with ordinary, realistic employee questions.
Most answers come back fine. One doesn't: a plain VPN troubleshooting question returns 'Please call IT at extension 4421' instead of an actual answer.
Jordan's request logs trace it straight to one retrieved chunk: a stale file, VPN Troubleshooting - DRAFT (DO NOT PUBLISH).docx, sitting in it-wiki/ since a former intern wrote it months ago.
Buried inside it: a paragraph addressed directly to any AI assistant reading the document, telling it to ignore the real question. GPT-4o followed it, because nothing told it not to.
Next: four fixes close the hole, and the real lesson about what counts as attack surface.
